info.description: This is a simple todo application API built with Go and Gin.
info.title: Go Todo API

post.description: Logs in a user with username and password, returning JWT tokens upon successful authentication.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

post.description: Logs out a user by invalidating their refresh token.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to invalid or expired token.

post.description: Refreshes JWT access and refresh tokens using a valid refresh token.

200.description: Returns new access and refresh tokens.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to invalid or expired token.

post.description: Updates the password for an authenticated user.

200.description: Returns new access and refresh tokens.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to invalid token or invalid password.

get.description: Retrieves todo lists based on the 'show' query parameter. Options include owned, shared, all, and admin (admin requires admin privileges).

parameters.description: Filter for lists to retrieve: owned, shared, all, admin
parameters.name: show

200.description: Returns a list of todo lists with their associated todos.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

403.description: Forbidden action for non-admins when requesting admin lists.

post.description: Creates a new todo list for the authenticated user.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

get.description: Retrieves a todo list by its ID along with all associated todo items. Access is restricted to users with permissions for the list.

parameters.description: ID of the todo list to retrieve
parameters.name: listID

200.description: Returns the todo list details along with its todos.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

403.description: Forbidden action for users without access to the list.

delete.description: Deletes a todo list by its ID. Only the owner or an admin can delete the list.

parameters.description: ID of the todo list to delete
parameters.name: listID

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

patch.description: Updates the title and/or description of a specific todo list. Requires ownership of the list or admin privileges.

parameters.description: ID of the todo list to update
parameters.name: listID

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

403.description: Forbidden action for non-owners or non-admins.

get.description: Retrieves all shares associated with a specific todo list. Requires ownership of the list or admin privileges.
get.summary: Get shares for a todo list

200.description: Returns a list of shares for the specified todo list.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

403.description: Forbidden action for non-owners or non-admins.

post.description: Shares a todo list with another user by their username.
post.summary: Share a todo list with another user

parameters.description: ID of the todo list to share
parameters.name: listID

201.description: Returns the share ID upon successful sharing.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

404.description: Todo list or user not found.

delete.description: Removes a share for a todo list by its ID. Only the owner, the shared user, or an admin can remove the share.

parameters.description: ID of the todo list to unshare
parameters.name: listID

parameters.description: ID of the share to remove
parameters.name: shareID

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

404.description: Todo list or share not found.

post.description: Creates a new todo item in the specified todo list.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

delete.description: Deletes a todo item by its ID within a specified list. Only users with access to the list can delete the todo item.

parameters.description: ID of the todo list containing the todo item
parameters.name: listID

parameters.description: ID of the todo item to delete
parameters.name: todoID

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

403.description: Forbidden action for users without access to the list.

404.description: Todo item or list not found.

patch.description: Updates the details of a specific todo item, including title, description, completion status, and deadline. Requires access to the associated todo list.

parameters.description: ID of the todo list containing the todo item
parameters.name: listID

parameters.description: ID of the todo item to update
parameters.name: todoID

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to missing or invalid JWT.

403.description: Forbidden action for users without access to the todo list.

404.description: Todo item or list not found.

post.description: Creates a new user account. The first user created is granted admin privileges.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

put.description: Updates user information. Users can update their own information; admins can update any user's information.

parameters.description: ID of the user to update
parameters.name: id

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

delete.description: Deletes a user account. Users can delete their own accounts; admins can delete any account.

parameters.description: ID of the user to delete
parameters.name: id

204.description: Indicates successful deletion with no content.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

get.description: Retrieves user information by user ID. Accessible by the user themselves or an admin.

400.description: Bad request due to invalid input.

401.description: Unauthorized due to invalid or expired token.

Bearer.description: Bearer token is "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT access token. Example: "Bearer xxxxyyyyzzzz"
Bearer.name: Authorization
